overview: The men in your life may leave you, children grow up, parents pass away. The only ones who are there for you, from cradle to grave, are your sisters.
title: Sisters

overview: Set in an air defense unit in a high-rise building in Seoul, the drama depicts the process of a soldier, Jae-yoon, and his girlfriend, Yeong-joo, who have just been notified of a breakup, running toward each other while fighting a horde of zombies.
title: Newtopia

overview: Anka Serafin, a young anthropologist from Krakow, who escapes to the mountains in search of herself and accidentally discovers a corpse. Anka quickly becomes entangled in solving a murder mystery, and her fate is inextricably intertwined with Sebastian, a journalist looking for sensations, and Jędrek, a local policeman with whom she was close as a teenager.
title: Śleboda

overview: Capi, a 12-year-old boy with a normal life, suffers from a terrible accident that causes him severe post-traumatic stress. No one seems to have more information: neither the school, his friends, nor his family can explain what has happened. However, the psychologist who treats him is willing to dive into his history and discover the reasons that have led him to this situation. Little by little, Capi begins to trust him and tells him that he has the power of invisibility, and that the terrible nightmares that lurk him every night have to do with the monsters and the dragon that haunt him. But in their history, they are not all threats. There is someone who does want to help you: a mysterious teacher, a newcomer to the institute, who will try by all means to make the invisible visible.
title: Invisible

overview: The Assembly will see celebrities being questioned by a remarkable group of inquisitive interviewers who are autistic, neurodivergent and/or learning disabled. Each episode of The Assembly sees a different celebrity forced to cast aside everything they were ever taught by their media trainers as they face their most honest, funny, chaotic – and heartwarming – interview yet.
title: The Assembly

overview: The Flip Off is a throwdown competition to see which ex can find, buy, renovate and flip a house for the biggest financial gain, earning the chance at ultimate bragging rights and a first-class vacation paid for by the loser.
title: The Flip Off

overview: A modern-day office worker is unexpectedly transported into the body of a noble princess, only to find herself deeply unwelcome. Even her newlywed husband, Prince Ling, gives her the cold shoulder. After enduring numerous pranks and humiliations, she makes a shocking discovery—the villain… is actually her? What's worse, she's even suspected of being involved in the mysterious death of Prince Ling's mother. Determined to turn her fate around, she introduces the people to stand-up comedy and brings scripted murder mysteries into the world of investigations. With endless tricks up her sleeve, she slowly catches the attention of the cold-faced prince. As they join hands, they uncover the truth behind the tragic fall of his mother…
title: Ruan Xiaofeng's Royal Love Quest

overview: Saviour introduces us to a well-brought up medical student, Ben, who goes to a fancy-dress party, dressed in a police uniform. Ben only has eyes for Xenia, and when he sees her being attacked by a man on his way home, he has no choice but to intervene, urged on by a bystander innocently assuming he was a real police officer. When things go awry, he makes a desperate call to his dad, who tells Ben exactly what to do next. Running parallel with Ben's story, we're introduced to Indy, a criminal barrister. Admired by all who work alongside her, Indy is going places as all her hard work, evening classes and dedication to her profession is beginning to pay off. When she meets a terrified Ben in a police cell, facing a charge of murder, she will have to navigate a world of police corruption, fervent press interest and a defendant who is keeping secrets from her. Throughout the drama we are left asking the question – how far are you prepared to go to protect the ones you love?
title: Saviour

overview: Meego is a 9,000-year-old shape-shifting alien from the planet Marmazon 4.0. After his spaceship crashes, he is discovered by three children; Trip , Maggie and Alex Parker. They live with their single father, Dr. Edward Parker and pass Meego off as human (he does not want anyone to know that he is extraterrestrial, and tells people he is from Canada instead). Although he plans to go home as soon as his ship is repaired, he becomes attached to the children and decides to remain on Earth to care for them.
title: Meego

overview: An android with the appearance of a teenager named Liam, helped by a group of young people, must escape the laboratory where he was secretly designed if he wants to avoid being reset. What he does not know is that a powerful weapon is hidden deep inside him. Beneath his appearance of a 16-year-old teenager, Liam is in fact an android secretly designed in the World Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. His existence must be revealed at the Belmont science fair, which will bring together young geniuses from all over the world. However, Liam must escape the laboratory, and quickly, because one of his creators, Dr. Wood, wants to reset him since he knows that the android has developed emotions. What Liam does not know is that a powerful weapon is hidden deep inside him. A few kilometers away, far from suspecting the terrible threat that is rumbling, Rafaële, 17, is preparing to welcome the most promising scientists to her father's inn. While she is participating in the inauguration of the science fair, she comes face to face with Liam. A strange connection unites them on the spot. Upset by the young android's dismay, she agrees to help him escape, then to hide him at her home. Lonely and hypersensitive, Rafaële is not convinced that she is the ideal candidate to save humanity. So she decides to turn to her cousin Alexis and the young people she is hosting: Osny, Anne and Rym. Together, they will have to protect Liam, thwart Dr. Wood's plans and lead the investigation to discover the secret hidden in Belmont Forest. What if everything was connected?
title: LIAM

overview: Kobe: The Making of a Legend traces the story of Kobe Bryant from his childhood in Italy to his athletic superstardom and provides an intimate look at his post-NBA aspirations as a storyteller and as a father. Featuring personal interviews with Kobe's former coaches, teammates and family friends, this illuminating series reveals the conflicts and the complications behind the man with the Black Mamba mentality.
title: Kobe: The Making of a Legend

overview: Nong is a village doctor deeply respected by his community. Despite constant pressure from political parties, he refuses to enter politics, determined to protect his patients and his principles. Vee, the ambitious and educated son of a party leader, believes wholeheartedly in Nong's integrity and talent. Desperate to recruit him, and to prove his own worth, Vee is willing to cross every line, setting off a covert game where politics and desire collide. As an election battle intensifies and buried secrets surface, their bond grows increasingly complicated by power, betrayal, and longing.
title: Mandate

overview: On the night of his greatest success, famous actor Armin dies after being betrayed by his lover. However, death is not the end. Going back in time and meeting mysterious fan TD, the path to superstardom begins again.
title: Reset

overview: Phee, an aspirant writer, insists to stay at the resort while its under renovation, an unexpected love blossoms between him and Arthit. What will happen when Arthit discovers their story was made into a novel? Will it lead to their romance gradually developing?
title: The Renovation

overview: Aurora Campero, president of Corporativo Campero, faces betrayal from her sister Jezabel, who manipulates a construction worker to assault her. Aurora becomes pregnant, and her fiancé, Antonio, abandons her upon discovering the truth. Don Miguel, her father, takes the baby away and gives him to a humble family. Twenty-nine years later, Gabriel, now named Ángel, falls in love with Helena, Antonio's daughter, while Aurora continues to search for her son. The return of Antonio and the schemes of Jezabel and Demián complicate their lives, but the power of love and forgiveness prevails.
title: El Ángel de Aurora

overview: Mu-jin is a labor attorney who gets paid for covering up the corruption of problematic companies while visiting labor sites with high industrial accident risks. One day, during an inspection of a factory, he faces a near-death crisis when steel materials collapse. At that moment, a Bodhisattva with a burning labor law book in hand appears before Mu-jin and forces him to sign a labor contract. Then, Mu-jin gains the ability to see ghosts, and to save his own life he also must solve various labor problems brought by the ghosts and resolve their grudges.
title: Oh My Ghost Clients

overview: 10 contestants battle to escape from a specially built prison in Hertfordshire, England. The first to break out wins £100,000 from a £250,000 prize fund, but if they work together on the escape they each get a share of the total amount.
title: Jailbreak

overview: It follows the life of student Yoon Ga Min, who wants to be good at studying but is only good at fighting, as he forms a study group at the worst school on earth and tells a fierce story about college entrance exams. Yoon Ga Min, who looks like a model student but is a student of Yusung Technical High School, which is one of the worst schools to study at. Although he studies extremely hard, his grades don't rise in the slightest. Despite all that, Yoon Ga Min sits diligently at his desk with the goal of going to college. However, when his study group friends get bullied, Yoon Ga Min takes off his glasses and school uniform jacket to put his fighting skills to use. Lee Han Kyeong, Yoon Ga Min's teacher, dreams of seeing the school change for the better. Lee Han Kyeong tutored Yoon Ga Min during her university days and reunites with him when she is appointed as a temporary teacher, holding a secret.
title: Study Group

overview: Rivals Fang Li and An Hang accidentally get trapped in a virtual world, becoming a married couple. With opposing system missions, they must defeat each other to return to reality. As they battle it out, they start to fall for each other. Can they rewrite the system's rules and find a way out?
title: Live or Love?

overview: World War II is over and the boys from the town of River Run, Ohio, are coming home. It seems that life is slowly getting back to normal, but the war has changed everything and they will never be the same again.
title: Homefront

overview: To marry into the Grand General's Mansion, Princess Mingzhu schemed against Su Qianqian's family, leading to their downfall. Determined to fight back, Su Qianqian entered the mansion alongside Mingzhu, where the two engaged in a fierce battle of wits. With the support of the young general Chu Junyao, Su Qianqian successfully avenged her family and won everyone's admiration with her extraordinary culinary skills.
title: Culinary Vendetta

overview: The series follows a brilliant and fearless "super detective" at the Hua'ao City Police Department, famed for solving every case that comes his way. But when a string of seemingly flawless murders occurs, his limits are pushed to the brink. The killer moves like a ghost, leaving no trace behind, as though they never existed. Amidst the shifting tides and hidden dangers of Hua'ao City, every shadow may conceal a deadly threat
title: Mobius

overview: The plot is based on the story of an orphan, Marta, who dreams of finding happiness, comfort, family and, most importantly, love
title: Ціна втечі

overview: A show in which stylist Alina German and comedian Sasha Vash invite stars to discuss their everyday looks, analyze mistakes and offer new options.
title: Стиль

overview: A headstrong female professor recruits a group of students to solve cold cases, recklessly pitting them against each other in the process.
title: Onopgelost

overview: Who has the best survival strategies? Who does the desert bring to its knees? And for whom giving up is not an option? In the Thai jungle, twelve reality stars have to demonstrate their survival instincts in teams of two and exchange familiar comfort for new skills: Melissa Heitmann and Yasin Mohamed, Michaela Barresi and Kevin Schäfer, Michelle Daniaux and Dominik Brcic, Aurelia Lamprecht and Micha Student, Zoe Saip and Juliano Fernández as well as Jade Britani and Paco Herb. Which adventurous duo will be able to make their way and fly home with 20,000 euros in prizes? Joyn will bring the successful reality format "Good Luck Guys" from France to Germany for the first time, exclusively and free on Joyn starting November 9, 2023.
title: Good Luck Guys

overview: One World is a half-hour comedy series that aired on the TNBC block from 1998 to 2001. The series followed the everyday issues of the Blake family in Miami. Ex-baseball player Dave Blake and his artist wife Karen have adopted six teens of various ethnic and racial backgrounds. The show was produced by Peter Engel Productions and canceled after three seasons.
title: One World

overview: Follow the lives of the locals in the seaside village of Mumbles, and find out what summer 2024 had in store.
title: Made in Mumbles

overview: Eight comedians come together to make you laugh, with skits about current events and life itself.
title: Humoretaten

overview: Lars Monsen is on the road again! Now he's hunting for spectacular nature experiences and useful knowledge about the unique nature we have chosen to protect.
title: Monsen og nasjonalparkene

overview: Captain Querini and his surviving crew drift ashore on Røst in 1432. Now 100 Røst residents want to take their story back to Italy – as an opera!
title: Drømmen om Venezia

overview: Alice senses the fine line between the worlds of the dead and the living and has been able to see ghosts since birth. She uses her gift to help a local investigator and is also eager to understand the circumstances of her mother's death.
title: Нерождённая

overview: A nightmare comes true for Igor Berestov, the protagonist of "Navigator." His new life begins on a suburban highway. It was there that he came to his senses and realized the past had been erased from his memory. Almost simultaneously, Berestov became the prime suspect in the case of the Jeweler, a serial killer with a distinctive signature who murders young girls and places pearls in their mouths. In the woods near the highway, Berestov stumbled upon the body of one of the victims. And when he touched the girl, he "saw" the whole crime scene...
title: Навигатор

overview: A laugh-a-minute romantic comedy where a 2025 feelings coach gets zapped into a cheesy vintage novel and meets her match, a 1999 CEO who's sweet on the outside but shrewd within. In the ultimate battle of romantic tactics, who will out-scheme whom? To get home, influencer Lin Huan'er launches an operation to win over CEO Gao Haiming, only for her clever plans to hilariously backfire. Just as her ticket home appears, she realizes her heart has already checked in for good. Can this cross-storybook couple write their own happy ending?
title: My Page in the 90s

overview: This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher's daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher's knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.
title: Pursuit of Jade

overview: Formula DRIFT has announced a television agreement with CBS Sports Network for 20 half-hour programs throughout the year. The fast paced action featuring bracketed head-to-head match-ups will anchor the coverage and be featured across 13 episodes. Coverage also includes an additional 7 shows featuring a brand new behind-the-scenes program, "Formula DRIFT Insider". "We are very excited about this new relationship with CBS Sports Network", said Ryan Sage, Vice President and Co-Founder of Formula DRIFT. "We have expanded our programming to nearly double the episodes and our new schedule is amazing! We look forward to exposing our sport to this national television audience in order to grow the sport and expose the new faces of Formula DRIFT". Formula DRIFT on CBS Sports Network premieres Wednesday, May 6 at 8:30 PM, ET. The Formula DRIFT schedule adds to CBS Sports Network's already robust lineup of motorsports programming, which includes 400 hours of coverage throughout the year.
title: Formula Drift

overview: DC and DC Studios are teaming up with Max to launch DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, a new unscripted video podcast series created as a one-stop destination for all things DC and DC Studios.
title: DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast

overview: They break you down and build you up. Strip you of your individuality. Roast you, train you, drill you. Everyone's got a boot camp story…this is Drill, a sketch comedy series that recreates and parodies those most iconic moments and stories with drill instructors and drill sergeants.
title: Drill

overview: Latvian-Ukrainian co-production series based on the events discussed in the documentary "Chernobyl 2022" – three young friends go on an extreme trip to the closed zone of Chernobyl, shortly before the Russian invasion. The main character Santa acts at the centre of the series. She goes to the Chernobyl zone for a video blog and meeting here recently on Tinder met love.
title: Čornobiļa 2022. Iebrukums

overview: The main character of the series, Artem Didov, is an almost forty-year-old presenter of wedding celebrations, a balladrasnik and the soul of the company. He lives a cheerful, carefree life, punctuated by odd jobs. Before the war, he loses everything - his bride leaves him, and later he becomes unemployed. On the eve of the invasion, Artem gets drunk and wakes up in the morning from explosions and a terrible hangover. Confused and devastated, Artem realizes that the war suddenly becomes a new reference point for him - a moment from which he can start building himself anew. Already in the training part, he is given the call sign "Tomboy", at first as a mockery, but later this call sign in the speech of his fellow students becomes more and more true respect. "Toaster" is not at all one of those who was born to be a hero, but forced to become one, although he treats it with a smile and humor.
title: Позивний "Тамада"

overview: The detective series ‘Ruban' tells about the work of a criminal psychologist who effectively and professionally solves criminal cases of high complexity with the help of his secret weapon - the subtleties of psychology.
title: Рубан

overview: A day before the start of a full-scale invasion, a young conductor receives a marriage proposal from the train master, but the beauty sees her future in a completely different way. But the war destroys all her plans. Polina's train becomes an evacuation train: instructions and timetables are in disarray, three times as many frightened and nervous passengers are crammed into the cars, there is a lack of water, food and medicine, a ruthless enemy is shooting from everywhere, and even the driver does not know the end point of the route. In addition, the scoundrel thief tries not only to make a small profit from human misery, but also to steal museum valuables that are being evacuated on the same flight.
title: Потяг

overview: The first love of classmates Anna and Andriy is overshadowed by Anna's involuntary betrayal. The lovers part ways - as they think, forever. Andriy becomes a professional military, while Anna builds a successful career and enjoys married life in Kyiv. Russian aggression changes everything once and for all. Both Andriy and Anna go through pain, suffering, loss of their loved ones, despair and hopelessness. Fate gives them the opportunity to start all over, but will Anna and Andriy manage to forgive past hurts and find love again?
title: Поклик кохання

overview: The protagonist, a psychologist who has a son with Asperger's syndrome, advises families with children suffering from various forms of autism spectrum disorder. Each episode is a separate story about the search for mutual understanding with a child whose world is very unusual and vulnerable. Such a "prism" reveals problems in the relationships of "normal" people. All the events take place in the midst of russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
title: Сімейний консультант

overview: At all times, people are divided into those who do something to change the world around them and those who say there is no point in resisting. A tsunami is an untamable phenomenon. You can build a breakwater, but it will pass by and wash everything away. But when creating the world God gave humanity hope and a way to protect itself against the ocean that can be so destructive... Mangrove. It is a tree that does not have the majesty of an oak or a sequoia. On the contrary, it is a gnarled tree, with crooked, towering roots that rise out of the water. But mangroves are the barrier that saves humanity from the tyranny of tsunamis. At a time when the invasion from russia was about to inevitably crush Ukraine, bleeding and disarmed, ordinary people stood in its way. People who decided that their lives and the future of our country depended on them. They are saving the country, even at the cost of their lives. While the whole world is watching, they are doing the impossible!
title: Мангровий гай

overview: According to the plot, four women found themselves in a country maternity hospital on the front line - blocked and under enemy fire. In a previous life, each of them suffered and made the decision to have a child in conditions of personal dilemmas and conflicts. Now they are not only fighting for their own survival, but also for the possibility of giving birth to their children.
title: Продовження роду

overview: OWN has made a home for award-winning investigative reporting from all three major broadcast networks. Joining CBS News' 48 Hours, 60 Minutes and NBC News' Dateline, 20/20 on OWN delivers a collection of stories about ordinary people facing extraordinary circumstances. It's hosted by ABC News chief law and justice correspondent Chris Cuomo, and features the reporters of ABC News' acclaimed series "20/20" who dig beneath the headlines to reveal stories of victims, their families, and the search for truth and justice.
title: 20/20 on OWN

overview: Tetyana Krutko, a well-known practicing psychologist with many years of experience, is a new teacher at the Institute of Psychology. She announces recruitment for the practical psychology course. To get to her course is the dream of many students. As a real pro, she likes to solve difficult problems, break stereotypes and teach on cases from real practice. The task of the course is to teach the basics of practical, effective psychology, because this is the first step to solving any life problems. Each lecture of the course is devoted to one specific topic: from the usual - why a personal life does not work out, to the realities dictated by how to survive a loss. The listeners are a group of students. The main thesis of the course: if I'm so smart, why don't I live as I would like?
title: Курс щасливого життя

overview: You never know where and when you might face an air raid alarm. These are eight different but incredible stories that would never have happened if the air raid alarm hadn't brought their protagonists together in a shelter. Each episode tells a completely new story with new characters, set in different parts of the country. The only thing all the stories have in common is the air raid alarm, which becomes the starting point of the plot.
title: Сховища. Вісім історій

overview: "Batya" is a 16-episode detective series about a distinguished operative, Lieutenant Colonel Stepan Trofimovich Bezbateko. After retiring, he hoped for a peaceful life, but his plans were drastically changed by the full-scale Russian invasion. After a year on the front lines and being wounded, Batya returns home. At the request of his daughter Lida, who works as a forensic expert, he agrees to help a young investigator solve a complicated murder case. Batya had no idea that this investigator was his son-in-law. After the truth came to light, the conflicts between the young and ambitious Yulian Synytskyi and the experienced operative only intensified. Will they be able to put their emotions aside to expose the criminals and save their family?
title: Батя

overview: The plot centres on the fate of a young man, Igor Shvedov: on the very first day he returns from the front, his elder brother, his only family member, is killed in front of him. But he suddenly learns that his brother was an influential criminal mastermind, and suspects that the people in his circle are not at all who they pretend to be. To find his brother's killer, he joins the police force and begins his war against organised crime and werewolves in uniform...
title: Подвійні ставки

overview: On New Year's Eve, in a tiny, cozy hotel in the Carpathians, fate, not without the help of the hotel owner Ivan, brings together very different people. Valera, a soldier of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, goes from the front line to the border to dissuade his wife from getting a divorce. Volunteer Tanya is unsuccessfully trying to raise money for a batch of drones and rushes to customs. Blogger Lisa just wants to live her cloudless and cheerful pre-war life. Deputy Petrovych dreams of escaping abroad with a suitcase of money. They all have very different dreams and views on life, but they will all meet the New Year together to understand what they really expect from the future.
title: ‎Новорічна шкереберть

overview: The series is about a small town in Ukraine occupied by Russian troops and the struggle of local residents for the future of Ukraine - the protection of young children from forced deportation to the aggressor country.
title: Батьківський комітет

overview: Trying to sell their grandfather's house, two friends hailing from "gilded youth" become victims of a fraudulent realtor. Two families of migrants fleeing from the war - from Crimea and Donbass - move into the twice-sold house. Completely different mentally, traditionally, and religiously, the families of Crimean Tatars and Ukrainians from Donetsk region are forced to coexist and find out who is in charge of the house. How will the problem with the fraud be resolved, will the two different families be able to live together, and will their domestic quarrels amid talk of a possible Russian invasion of Ukraine interfere with the emergence and flourishing of love between their children?
title: Шлях додому

overview: Darryl Hughley moved his family from the inner city to the suburbs, and the neighborhood hasn't been the same since. Part Archie Bunker, part George Jefferson; with an opinion about everything, Darryl Hughley knows exactly why he moved to there. Let's just hope the suburbs can survive the move. Based on comedian D. L. Hughley's real-life experiences, Darryl is a stubborn man, totally devoted to his wife Yvonne and trying to raise his head-strong kids in an upwardly mobile world that he fears will spoil them. Together, the "vending machine king" and his friend and employee Milsap, who has followed the Hughleys to the suburbs, make life difficult for their tall, loud, very white neighbor Dave. Meanwhile, Dave's wife Sally, who has bonded with Yvonne, tries to apply her professional skills as a psychologist to the neighborhood with hilarious results.
title: The Hughleys

overview: Ukraine is striving to become a part of the European Union, sharing European values and standards of state structure. In order to improve the overall culture and efficiency of the police, Ukraine is conducting an experiment: a special operational and demonstration group (OG) is being created in the bowels of the Kyiv Police Department.
title: ОПГ

overview: In the middle of the Cold War, a Soviet submarine runs aground outside Karlskrona and suddenly Sweden finds itself at the center of events. Prime Minister Thorbjörn Fälldin tries to resolve the conflict and avoid a world war between two nuclear powers while struggling with a wise foreign minister and a belligerent commander-in-chief.
title: Whiskey on the Rocks

overview: A raw and intimate docu-series following Britain's biggest influencer, Molly-Mae Hague. With unprecedented access to Molly and her family in the months after the break-up that shook the world, we follow her as she launches her clothing brand and navigates life as a single Mum. Strong, vulnerable and driven, the series reveals a different side to Molly-Mae.
title: Molly-Mae: Behind it All

overview: Having been a "Friend of 7Bravo" since February 2023 and familiar face on Australian television, Bella will now be front and centre at Australia's biggest awards shows and fashion events, showcasing all the red-carpet glamour and hosting celebrity interviews with Live From E! on 7Bravo.
title: Live From E!

overview: Don't miss this festive celebration with Delta Goodrem as she brings her annual Christmas show to life with friends old and new.
title: Christmas with Delta

overview: In this heartwarming Christmas comedy, eternally single Mina lets her family find her a date so she won't be alone this Christmas. Who will sit next to her at Christmas dinner?
title: Single Bells

overview: New RTÉ Documentary Michael Lynn: The Fugitive asks where did the money go? One of the loose ends that still exists with the Michael Lynn story is the question of what happened with the money. Virtually none of which has been recovered. When solicitor Michael Lynn fled Ireland in December 2007, he'd clocked up €80m in loans from high street banks, much of them fraudulently secured via multiple mortgages. And he owed another €12m to private investors who had paid out for unbuilt apartments abroad. A new two-part documentary series beginning on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player tonight, highlights new links involving a Bulgarian business associate of Michael Lynn's setting up companies in Ireland relating to property development, and those company accounts being accessed by Mr Lynn's wife, Brid Murphy withdrawing cash in the last year. Michael Lynn: The Fugitive reveals the true story of an epic hunt to bring one of Ireland's most notorious fugitives to justice told directly by the reporter who tracked him down, his victims, and former employees. The two-part series is directed by Trevor Birney and produced by Fine Point Films for RTÉ. Irish Mail on Sunday Journalist Michael O'Farrell and photographer Sean Dwyer ended up hunting Michael Lynn down all over the world, from Portugal to Bulgaria to a hellhole prison in Brazil. Michael Lynn was facing serious questions about his fraudulent actions in Ireland when he fled to Portugal. They spotted someone tearing up documents and leaving them outside Lynn's offices in Portugal one night. When they got them back to the hotel and pieced them together, it was a treasure trove of information on Lynn. They had discovered a cache of discarded documents in Portugal which led them deeper into Lynn's labyrinth of lies.
title: Michael Lynn - The Fugitive

overview: On his twenty-first birthday, Sam Oliver discovers his parents sold his soul to the devil before he was born, and he must now serve as the devil's personal bounty hunter or Reaper, catching escaped souls and sending them back to Hell.
title: Reaper

overview: A brother searches for his missing sister, a dancer, while two gangs engage in a fierce war for control of Pigalle's nightlife.
title: Pigalle, la nuit

overview: Follow New Jersey police as they tackle drunk, drugged, and reckless driving. With the highest traffic-related deaths in 15 years, New Jersey has a lot at stake. We gain unique access to two police departments, where cameras reveal the daily challenges faced by officers striving to maintain safety on the 39,000 miles of highway. From dashcam footage showing shocking incidents nationwide to the humorous moments on the job, witness the chaotic reality of policing as in Clifton, New Jersey.
title: Motorway Cops: Catching America's Speeders

overview: Clare Balding returns to celebrate the unbreakable bond we have with our dogs, sharing emotional stories of missing dogs, their dramatic rescues and joyful reunions with their owners.
title: Lost Dog, Found Dog with Clare Balding

overview: This series is packed full of ingenious ways to feel healthier, save cash and smash your way into the New Year, with your trusted air fryer by your side. Presented by Cherry Healey, we compare and contrast all your favourite meals and treats with an air fryer version. Nutritionist Jenny Tschiesche counts the calories, while air fryer chef Dan Edwards recommends fast and furious food that also works wonders for the waistline.
title: The Air Fryer Diet: Lose Weight Fast

overview: LUMINARE CHRISTMAS! creates a magical atmosphere that's perfect for all ages, fueled by sonically lush vocal and instrumental musical performances. Their iconic sound can be described as a combination of Mannheim Steamroller's classic holiday vibes, with the high-energy rock of Trans-Siberian Orchestra, and the stirring cinematic atmosphere of Hans Zimmer. The end result is a musical fusion for the senses that is sure to captivate audiences.
title: Luminare Christmas!

overview: A Spice Girl, a ballroom star, a Wimbledon champ and more walk into a jungle — and only one can emerge victorious. Who will be the last celebrity standing?
title: Celebrity Bear Hunt

overview: Lin Chuan, haunted by a classmate's mysterious death, spends ten years searching for the truth. Meanwhile, Shen Xia and her brother Shen Dong are drawn into a criminal underworld after a family tragedy. As their paths collide, a tense showdown between justice and crime unfolds, blending love, hate, and revenge in a captivating story.
title: The Appearance of the Murderer

overview: Getting By is an American sitcom that aired on ABC from March 5, 1993 until May 21, 1993, and on NBC from September 21, 1993 until June 18, 1994. The series was created by William Bickley and Michael Warren, who also served as executive producers with Thomas L. Miller and Robert L. Boyett. The final Miller-Boyett series to begin its run under parent studio Lorimar Television, Getting By was folded into Warner Bros. Television for its second season, following Warner Bros.' absorption of Lorimar.
title: Getting By

overview: From a young age, Zhou Chu, the commander of the Xuanjia Army, had disguised herself as a man. Upon her triumphant return to Beizhao, she was ambushed, only to discover that the culprit was none other than her sworn brother, Deputy General Xu Hanzhi. Rescued by her former battlefield rival, Shang Kefeng, Zhou Chu reclaimed her female identity and assumed the alias Xue Shisan. She infiltrated Dengying Tower to seek revenge on Xu Hanzhi, who resided there. She maneuvered between the two men in her quest for truth, feigning submission while treading a perilous path at every turn.
title: Always My General

overview: Join Belfast comedians Shane Todd and Ciarán Bartlett for a new sketch show showcasing the best of Northern Ireland's new comic talent. From cringe-worthy encounters to moments of pure slapstick, the show will feature sketches on the creation of the horse on day six of the universe; the inevitable outbreak of a Mafia war at the hands of a dodgy go-between; bad life and business coaching, and sketches depicting scenes of comedic modern ‘torture'. Expect cinematic parodies, surprising twists, and the kind of humour that only Northern Ireland's comedy scene can deliver.
title: Chancers

overview: Atmospheric show by Rasul Chabdarov and Pavel Dedishchev. You will see stand-up comedians, cool guests, friendly communication and live music.
title: Комьюнити

overview: The Stifel Snow Show brings fans unparalleled access to every sport on the FIS World Cup circuit, including alpine skiing, snowboarding, freeskiing, cross country and more. Hosted by NBC Sports' Ahmed Fareed and Cara Banks, the show blends in-depth analysis, recaps of the week's action and interviews with athletes and experts.
title: Stifel Snow Show

overview: History is made in moments where life hangs in the balance; when split-second decisions mean the difference between disaster and survival; when the safe, orderly world disintegrates into chaos. These are the moments that populate the pantheon of History's Most Shocking. This show takes viewers frame-by-frame into the most significant mind-blowing events ever caught on camera. From chilling accidents to natural disasters to extreme sports fails to harrowing animal attacks, History's Most Shocking is a deep dive into the extreme, uncovering the truth behind what happened. It not only captivates the eye; it also provides key takeaways into what went wrong, and what needs to be avoided in the future. With compelling first-person narratives from the people who lived through these seminal moments and expert analysis identifying the miscalculations and misjudgments that caused them, History's Most Shocking won't just keep you on edge of your seat…. It will teach you the history lessons you were never taught in school.
title: History's Most Shocking

overview: Thousands of abandoned children, doomed to die on the outskirts of cities - Each year, 20 of them find themselves in the arena of a reality TV show. Determined not to fall back into poverty, they face a fierce competition to win the jackpot and be adopted by a celebrity couple. But this time around, the rules are changing.
title: Bâtards

overview: Provides an immersive experience of Nepal's rich cultural history and traditions. The series showcases Nepal's ancient rituals that celebrate the relationship between brother and sister, elders, animals and honouring deceased family members.
title: Festivals

overview: "Boston" Rob Mariano sits down with eliminated players to break down gameplay, talk drama on the island and share never-before-seen footage from the latest episode of Deal or No Deal Island.
title: Deal or No Deal Island After Show

overview: Vital Signs is a British television drama series airing on ITV from 2006. It stars Tamzin Outhwaite as a supermarket check-out operator who decides to become a doctor. The series co-stars William Beck, Fraser Ayres, Eve Best, Claudie Blakley, Lucinda Dryzek, Beth Goddard, Alfie Hunter, Brooke Kinsella, Harry Lloyd, Peter Rnic and Steven Waddington. The filming of the show is based in numerous London hospitals and medical schools; predominantly the show has been shot in St George's Hospital and Medical School.
title: Vital Signs

overview: For nine months of the year, the peaceful towns around central Missouri's Lake of the Ozarks are home to just a few thousand residents. However, when summer arrives, millions of tourists flock to the area, seeking fun on the water and vibrant nightlife in the bars. This surge transforms the serene environment into a bustling hub, putting extra pressure on local law enforcement. In this new 10-episode series, viewers join the Lake Ozark Police Department and Osage Beach Police Department on their daily patrols, witnessing firsthand the challenges they face in maintaining order and ensuring safety in this lively midwestern destination.
title: Ozark Law

overview: Kugel, the captivating prequel to Shtisel, takes viewers on an emotional journey into the lives of Nuchem and Libbi, father and daughter, set in Antwerp's Orthodox Jewish community. Nuchem, played brilliantly by Sasson Gabay, is a witty jewelry dealer whose charm lies as much in his storytelling as in his trade. His daughter, Libbi, portrayed by Hadas Yaron, is a seminar teacher yearning to make her mark in the Orthodox literary world.
title: Kugel

overview: Vacationland follows top LAPD detective Grace Chen after she resigns from her job in disgust. She retires to the quirky village of Serenity, Maine, determined to put it all behind her. When Serenity's Sheriff is murdered, however, Grace finds herself dragged back into crime fighting by Joey, a local veterinarian and amateur sleuth determined to protect the town she loves. Between Grace's big-city detective skills and Joey's understanding of Maine, they turn out to be a surprisingly effective team … and a very unlikely pair of friends.
title: Vacationland

overview: In 1896, Villaveza del Agua is an impoverished town where two rival widows, Garibalda and Atilana, engage in a power struggle. This battle drags their children into a cursed inheritance, and neither can see the impact until it's too late.
title: La sombra de la tierra

overview: A series of documentaries about the history of Russian animation, dedicated to the 85th anniversary of the Soyuzmultfilm studio. Each of the 15 films tells about the main stages of the development of animation art in our country, about the unique achievements of Russian animation and its influence on world art. Also, an important part of the film will be a description of the historical events against which animated films of different eras were created.
title: Кто нас нарисовал?
